Resolutions of 1961

10 resolutions, 30% unanimous. Decolonisation.

  • 161 (1961) The death of Patrice Lumumba and reorganization of Congolese armed forces
  • 162 (1961) The situation between Israel and Jordan
  • 163 (1961) The mandate of the Subcommittee on the situation in Angola
  • 164 (1961) Complaint by Tunisia
  • 165 (1961) Admission of Sierra Leone to membership in the United Nations
  • 166 (1961) Admission of Mongolia to membership in the United Nations
  • 167 (1961) Admission of Mauritania to membership in the United Nations
  • 168 (1961) Appointment of U Thant as Acting Secretary-General of the United Nations
  • 169 (1961) An arms embargo against the Congo (capital Leopoldville)
  • 170 (1961) Admission of Tanganyika to membership in the United Nations

Security Council Record is an independent record of every resolution, vote and veto of the United Nations Security Council since 1946. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by the United Nations. For official documents, use the Security Council website and the UN Digital Library.
